_about: Unit types and qualities (RULES.md §4–§5, §8). 1 unit ≈ 5 infantry divisions; attack and defence strength both equal current steps. 'symbol' is how the counter is drawn (docs/STYLE.md §5). 'roadDistance': how many territories a road move may cover. 'canSplit': pieces of this type can be split and merged (§8). 'rank' orders the qualities: a merged piece takes the lower. See docs/DATA.md.

qualities.name: Green
qualities.effect: If more than half the attacking steps are Green: −1 column.

qualities.name: Elite
qualities.effect: If any Elite unit attacks: +1 column.
